description: Students engage with applied topics to increase knowledge, skills, and habits for student success.
Topics vary to support first- and second-year students who seek sustained supplemental support for
their college transition. Courses commonly emphasize the theory and practice of how to learn,
navigate academic cultures and communities, develop a sense of belonging, advocate for educational
and personal support, and identify and deepen individual strengths through coursework and
sustained reflection. P/N only. Prerequisite: Instructor permission.
